name: Sangal Esports
desc: Professional esports organisation founded in Turkey in 2017 by Emre Ergül, fielding Counter-Strike 2 and Valorant teams, headquartered in the Netherlands since 2021.
customers: fans; sponsors such as 1xBet and Kaspersky
markets: Netherlands and Turkey; competes in international Counter-Strike 2 events

signals.what: Reached the grand final of Stake Ranked Episode 6 in Barcelona (lost 3-1 to Luminosity Gaming)

fit_rationale: Small esports team that is itself a sponsorship seller (main sponsor 1xBet); no revenue or headcount published, so it is a weak buyer of F1 rights.
outstanding: No financials, headcount or owner details published; esports orgs are sellers rather than buyers of sponsorship.

name: Tivoli Brewing
desc: Denver craft brewer ranked 18th among US craft brewing companies by 2025 volume; its website now redirects to its Outlaw Light beer brand.
products: beer, including Outlaw Light ('Mile Hi Light Beer')
customers: retail and on-trade beer drinkers in the US
markets: United States (Colorado-based; distribution footprint not stated)

alt_indicators.evidence: No. 18 of the 2025 Top 50 US Craft Brewing Companies and No. 28 of the Top 50 Overall US Brewing Companies (Brewers Association, by volume)

fit_rationale: Regional US beer brand; only the US Grands Prix match, and beer is a crowded F1 category (Heineken), so fit is weak despite a fast-growing light-beer brand.
outstanding: Owner, revenue, employees and distribution states not found; relationship between Tivoli and Outlaw Light inferred from the domain redirect.

name: Worldwide Clinical Trials
desc: Global midsize contract research organisation running clinical trials in oncology, neuroscience, internal medicine, rare disease and cell and gene therapy.
markets: clinical operations in more than 60 countries across Europe, the Americas and Asia Pacific

alt_indicators.evidence: clinical operations across more than 60 countries; offices in 25 countries

signals.what: Agreed sale of its Clinical Pharmacology Unit and Bioanalytical Laboratory operations to Fortrea; divestiture of Early Phase Services completed 19 Oct 2026

fit_rationale: Niche B2B CRO selling to pharma sponsors; global footprint matches the calendar but buyers are scientific teams who are rarely won through motorsport hospitality.
outstanding: Owner, revenue and headcount not found; only one Route C indicator (country footprint). HQ country not stated on pages opened (input left blank).

name: HiSky
desc: Moldovan low-cost airline group founded in 2019, flying from Chișinău and, as HiSky Europe, from Bucharest to Europe, North Africa and the US.
marketing_autonomy_basis: founded and run by CEO Iulian Scorpan (Wikipedia)
stores_or_sites: fleet of about 8-9 Airbus aircraft (HiSky 1, HiSky Europe 7-8)
markets: Moldova and Romania to about 17 countries in Europe, North Africa, the Middle East and the US

alt_indicators.evidence: bases in Moldova and Romania; destinations in about 17 countries

fit_rationale: Small Moldovan-Romanian low-cost carrier with under ten aircraft and no published revenue; too small for F1 rights and few calendar markets.
category_conflict: potential: airline category held by Qatar Airways (Formula 1 global partner)
outstanding: Revenue and passenger numbers not found; fleet counts inconsistent on Wikipedia.

name: Mephisto
desc: French comfort-shoe brand tied to the Michaeli family, selling Mephisto, Mobils, Allrounder and Sano shoes online and through stores in Europe.
products: walking and comfort shoes (Mephisto, Mobils, Allrounder, Sano)
customers: consumers via own stores, retailers and e-commerce
marketing_autonomy_basis: family brand (site history text names the Michaeli family)
markets: web shops for Germany, Austria, Belgium, Spain, France, Italy, Netherlands, UK, Switzerland

alt_indicators.evidence: country web shops in nine European markets

signals.what: Rainbow model selected for '100 Icônes du Style Français' (L'étiquette)

fit_rationale: Comfort-shoe brand for an older customer base; European markets match some races, but the product and audience sit far from F1's premium-performance image.
outstanding: Revenue, employees and store count not found; Wikipedia pages not available.
